name: Mental Arithmetic
subtitle: Lessons and timed practice
promotionalText: Practice addition and multiplication in ten-question rounds, with clear numerals and your answer times at the end of each set.
description:
Practice mental addition and multiplication with a simple, focused interface. Choose one-, two-, or three-digit operands, then complete ten unique problems in each round.

Answers submit automatically when the required number of digits has been entered. Each submission moves immediately to the next problem. A live timer accompanies the answer field, and the previous answer's completion time appears in black for correct or red for incorrect. At the end of a round, see your score out of ten and your maximum, minimum, and average answer times. Start each new round yourself.

Learn provides instructions and random examples for all six operation and digit-count combinations. Addition shows the digit calculations and carries. Two-digit multiplication follows First, Inside, Outside, and Last; three-digit multiplication combines five groups of digit products. Follow the carry steps and see the final answer after the calculations. The confirmed 12 × 12 and 18 × 18 demonstrations are also available.

The app runs locally without an account, advertisements, analytics, or an internet connection. Its sepia background and large Arial numerals keep attention on the arithmetic.
